environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance with PostgreSQL 15. The DATABASE_URL connects as role 'appuser' which has full CRUD privileges (GRANT ALL ON users TO appuser). No SIGNING_KEY env var is set, so the hardcoded SHARED_SECRET is used. The attacker can observe the auth token generation pattern and forge reset tokens since the same key and HMAC construction is used for both purposes (only the 'purpose' prefix differs, which is guessable).

config.database_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO appuser
